articleTitle: Multi-source Knowledge Embedding Research of Knowledge Graph
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Circuits, Systems and Devices (ICCSD)
abstract: In recent years, the knowledge graph has developed rapidly, but a single knowledge graph often fails to meet people's needs for actual use. Therefore, the multi-source knowledge embedding of knowledge graph has received extensive attention. Multi-source knowledge embedding was mainly divided into three steps: knowledge search, knowledge evaluation and knowledge fusion. The knowledge search was the basis of multi-source knowledge embedding. Knowledge evaluation was the guarantee of multi-source knowledge embedding. Knowledge fusion was the main means of multi-source knowledge embedding. Multi-source knowledge embedding can not only improve the performance of knowledge representation, but also improve the completeness of knowledge graph. At present, people mainly paid attention to the embedding of knowledge, ignoring the knowledge search and knowledge evaluation. This paper studied the whole process of knowledge embedding from the perspective of knowledge source, which was of great significance.

articleTitle: Calculation of Capacitance Parameters of XLPE Submarine Cable Based on Finite Element Method
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Circuits, Systems and Devices (ICCSD)
abstract: XLPE submarine cable is an important transmission channel for cross-sea interconnection of power grid. It requires high comprehensive electrical performance. The capacitance rise phenomenon of XLPE submarine cable needs to be focused on, which requires accurate capacitance parameters of XLPE submarine cable. In this paper, a two-dimensional finite element model of single-core and three-core XLPE optical fiber composite submarine cable is established by using finite element method (FEM). The energy of element is calculated when applying different potentials between the core and armor, and then the capacitance parameters of submarine cables are obtained. Results can be used as a comparative verification of the actual measurement, and also provide accurate capacitance parameters for fault analysis.

articleTitle: A Review of Line Loss Analysis of the Low-Voltage Distribution System
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Circuits, Systems and Devices (ICCSD)
abstract: The line loss analysis of low-voltage distribution systems is the most important way to promote the scientificity and rationality of low-voltage power system construction, transformation and operation. In this paper, the traditional theoretical calculation method and artificial intelligence-based algorithm for the low-voltage distribution system line loss analysis are introduced, and the further research of line loss analysis of the low-voltage distribution system is prospected.

Author Keywords: traditional theoretical line loss calculation methods

articleTitle: Optimal Energy Transaction Ledger Model for Microgrid Energy Trading
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Circuits, Systems and Devices (ICCSD)
abstract: Nowadays, renewable energy plays an important role in producing electrical power. The energy distribution in microgrid is a new way to exchange energy between ledger and prosumers. The blockchain technology has been proven to provide security for the transactions in microgrid. The purpose of this paper is to present the model of energy ledger for microgrid electrical energy transaction and to simulate energy trading between ledger and prosumers. The simulation result shows the significant cost reduction on prosumer monthly electricity bill, varying by the level of solar cell and battery installation. Furthermore, in the future, the model can be implemented in the real microgrid system.

articleTitle: Online Theoretical Power Loss Calculation and Management System
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Circuits, Systems and Devices (ICCSD)
abstract: Power system loss wastes valuable energy, which is of great importence to reduce energy loss, and promote the management of online theoretical line loss. An online theoretical power loss calculation and management system is designed. First, a framework of online theoretical calculation is put forward. Secondly, the data acquisition and preprocessing is described in detail. Then, the practical method for improving the theoretical calculation of power loss is proposed. Finally, according to the theoretical calculation results, the system for power loss reduction planning is designed. The system is applied to the theory calculation and analysis of power grid, which improves work efficiency and automation, reduces the workload.

articleTitle: Dispatch in Electric Vehicles Embedded Virtual Power Plants Considering Safety Constraints
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Circuits, Systems and Devices (ICCSD)
abstract: Virtual power plant (VPP) is an effective way to coordinate multiple types of energy such as electric vehicles (EV) and wind power. To optimize the utilization of VPP involving multiple energy sources, a two-layer scheduling model for VPP considering safety constraints are build. Under the premise of safety constraints such as system flow, node voltage, and line transmission power, the upper layer model is aimed at maximizing revenue of the virtual power plant and minimizing its output variance by making charging schedules for EV agent, conventional load, and the output of VPP. The lower layer model is aimed at minimizing deviation between the actual output of the EV group and charging schedules of EV agent by optimizing the charging curve of each EV. A IEEE30 node test system with one wind power agent, one EV agent and two conventional load agents is taken as example to illustrate its validity. The results show that the model can realize the coordinated optimization of wind power, EV and conventional load, improve revenue of VPP and the fluctuation of its output.

articleTitle: Simplification and Hardware Parallel Design of Frobenius Mapping Algorithm Based on SM9
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Circuits, Systems and Devices (ICCSD)
abstract: With the development of network technology, the leakage of information has become a severe security risk, which has led to the increasing requirements for the security and processing speed of information encryption and decryption. This paper mainly optimizes the algorithm of R-ate bilinear pairing with the parameters of the SM9 and reduces its hardware cost by simplifying the Frobenius mapping algorithm. The validity of the optimized algorithm was verified based C++ from the view of software, and hardware parallelization design also was realized based FPGA respectively. The synthesis results on Xilinx Virtex-7 of the Twelfth Domain Mode Multiplication module showed that it consumes 28% of the Slice registers and 57% of the LUT. This research proposed an effective approach for accelerating the R-ate algorithm and reducing chip area.

articleTitle: Research on Eddy Current Testing Technology for Lead Seal Crack Defects of High Voltage Cable
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Circuits, Systems and Devices (ICCSD)
abstract: Because of the advantages of reliable sealing performance, high mechanical strength and good aging resistance, the lead seal of HV cable has been widely used in joint and terminal of HV cable. In order to ensure the safe and stable operation and improve service life of HV cable lines, it is necessary to carry out regular inspection and evaluation of lead seal state to reduce the potential safety hazards caused by lead seal crack. In this paper, the reasons leading to lead seal crack were analyzed. The common crack defeats testing methods were compared. The possibility of using eddy current testing technology to detect the crack of lead seal HV cable was verified by simulation using FEM software COMSOL, simulation test, on-site test, et al. The result shows that eddy current testing technology can effectively detect the lead seal crack defects of HV cables. And the impedance amplitude and phase change of the probe coil will be more obvious when the lead seal cracking is more serious.

articleTitle: 30 GHz Monolithically Integrated Frequency Multiplier Based on GaN Planar Schottky Barrier Diode
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Circuits, Systems and Devices (ICCSD)
abstract: A 30 GHz monolithically integrated frequency multiplier based on the planar GaN Schottky barrier diode are successfully fabricated. The impact of material parameters and anode dimension on the frequency multiplier are investigated. The use of the monolithic integrated approach significantly improves the performance of the GaN frequency multiplier. The frequency multiplier gains a more than 3 dBm output power with frequency range from 21.5 to 39.5 GHz. The maximum output power is 9.68 dBm at 28.5 GHz with efficiency up to 16.1%. At the central frequency of 30 GHz, the output power is 9.64 dBm with 15.0% efficiency.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Influence of Virtual Synchronous Machine on Power Transmission Limit Based on Bifurcation Theory
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Circuits, Systems and Devices (ICCSD)
abstract: The access of wind turbines to the power grid will bring new challenges to the safe and stable operation of power systems. When the wind turbine adopts the virtual synchronous control strategy, it can match the characteristics of the traditional synchronous generator and solve the unstable operation problem caused by the lack of inertia. In this paper, the influence mechanism of virtual synchronous machine (VSM) model on voltage stability of power system is analyzed with bifurcation theory. The increase of the damping coefficient of the VSM and the reduction of the inertia time constant will be beneficial to the voltage stability, which can provide a basis for the wind power transmission limit.

articleTitle: Analysis of Lightning Performance of Overhead Transmission Lines with Insulator Parallel Gaps
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Circuits, Systems and Devices (ICCSD)
abstract: Lightning is one of the major threats to the operation of high voltage overhead transmission lines. To improve the lighting performance of overhead transmission lines, various lighting protection measures are used. The major challenge in choosing lightning protection measures is that it's difficult to quantitatively evaluate how these measures changes the lightning performance of the transmission lines. Parallel gap is used to protect insulator from the arc caused by lightning discharge. Based on a large-scale insulator parallel gap installation project, this work analyzed relationship between the insulator parallel gap installation and the lighting performance of the transmission lines. This work first proposed a method for evaluation of lightning performance of existing overhead transmission lines, and then the method was applied to groups of transmission lines installed with insulator parallel gaps. Finally, the lightning performance of the transmission lines before and after the installation of insulator parallel gaps are compared and analyzed.

articleTitle: Optimization Design of Wireless Charging Magnetic Coupling Coil Based on Finite Element
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Circuits, Systems and Devices (ICCSD)
abstract: The principle analysis of the wireless charging magnetic coupling coil is carried out, and the loss calculation of the magnetic coupling coil, the magnetic core and the shielding plate is studied. Through theoretical and simulation analysis, it can be known that the transmission efficiency and anti-offset ability of the square magnetic coupling coil is better than the circular magnetic coupling coil. The experimental results verify the theoretical design feasibility. The theoretical design efficiency of the square magnetic coupling coil is 97.5%, the maximum efficiency of prototype experiment of the magnetic coupling coil is 96.61%, the two results are consistent which providing support for accurately calculating the efficiency of the magnetic coupling coil.

articleTitle: Auxiliary Envelope Tracking Focused Investigations of a 10W GaN HEMTs Device
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Circuits, Systems and Devices (ICCSD)
abstract: This paper examines the application of a broadband modulated measurement system, and specifically how such a system can be used in combination with active IF load-pull in order to characterize a device whilst operating in an Auxiliary Envelope Tracking (AET). The AET modifies dynamically the instantaneous DC applied to the device through the optimization of baseband impedance. The experimental measurements are carried out on a GaN HEMTs device to investigate the idea of improving the linearity of the device using the very mechanism that is employed to improve efficiency of the device. The investigations have shown a significant improvement in linearity of the device.

articleTitle: Research on Ferroresonance of Electromagnetic Voltage Transformer in 550kV HGIS
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Circuits, Systems and Devices (ICCSD)
abstract: For a 550kV HGIS electromagnetic voltage transformer(PT), ferromagnetic resonance occured after the disconnector was opened. In this paper, firstly, considering the ferromagnetic resonance condition, the fault disintegration, fault recording, and operating overvoltage datas were analyzed to analyze the causes of ferromagnetic resonance.Then a HGIS simulation model was built by EMTP-ATP to calculate very fast transient voltage which was caused by opening operation of disconnector. According to the results, the VFTO amplitude at the PT is not large, but the wave front steepness reaches 2837kV/ μs, which is harmful to the inter-turn insulation of the PT primary winding. It may cause partial inter-turn short circuit and then induce core saturation. Finally, the preventive measures of ferromagnetic resonance are proposed.

articleTitle: Optimization Methods for Deterministic Thread Library Dthreads Scheduling
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Circuits, Systems and Devices (ICCSD)
abstract: Dthreads is a multi-core deterministic thread library with good performance in recent years. It has great application value for programs with deterministic execution requirements. This paper focus on Dthreads scheduling process. In view of program's potential parallelism characteristics and the requirement of determinism, two optimization methods are introduced to improve the parallelism. The validity and performance of these two methods are verified by experiments. The results show that the two optimization methods can improve the running efficiency of program and guarantee determinism.

articleTitle: An Experimental Investigation on the Correlation between Corona Current Pulse and the Ground Level Ion Flow Field
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Circuits, Systems and Devices (ICCSD)
abstract: The radio interference and ion flow field are two main undesired effects produced by high voltage transmission lines. Since the radio interference is induced by corona current pulse, a corona discharge experiment from wire to ground electrode was conducted to study the relationship between corona current pulse and the ground level ion flow field. Through the simultaneous measurement of both components, the correlations between the single and continuous waveforms are systematically investigated. At last, based on the found out correlations, one method to simulate ion flow field using the corona current pulse is proposed.

articleTitle: Intelligent Recognition Mobile Platform Based on STM32
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Circuits, Systems and Devices (ICCSD)
abstract: Aiming at the automatic transportation of industrial materials, a mobile platform capable of automatically identifying materials is designed. The platform takes the robot as the implement, takes the material handling as the objection, and uses the smart camera to recognize and intelligently capture automatically. The platform uses STM32F407 as SCM controller, uses Pixy image recognition sensor as the smart camera, and other hardware parts mainly include power supply circuit, motor drive circuit, grayscale acquisition circuit, OLED display circuit and voice prompt circuit. The experimental results shows, the intelligent mobile platform meets the requirements, can accurately identify the materials, independently plan the path, and carry out intelligent handling. The techniques are extended to address the problem of automobile production.

articleTitle: Fault Analysis and Simulation Test Research on Lightning Stroke-Caused Wire-Breakage of Overhead Ground Line
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Circuits, Systems and Devices (ICCSD)
abstract: In important spanning sections of overhead transmission lines, once a serious accident such as tower collapse, wire breakage, or string loss occurs, it may have bad impact on grid security and public safety. In this paper, for the lightning stroke-caused wire-breakage fault of the overhead ground line, the discharge phenomenon of the helical backup wire clamp by lightning current is found for the first time. The cause of the wire-breakage is analyzed in depth and simulated lightning stroke test is carried out. The results show that the fault of the lightning stroke-caused wire-breakage is caused by violent discharge of the lightning current through the helical backup ground clamp. After the ground wire of the clamp is injured, it gradually breaks under stress concentration, then fall and contact with the A-phase conductor. The resulting power frequency short-circuit current causes the ground wire in the middle position to be melted again; there is obvious discharge phenomenon at the end of the helical wire clamp under the simulated lightning stroke, but the end contact of the wedge wire clamp is relatively good, which can reduce the hidden danger of lightning stroke discharge, and it is recommended to be used as backup wire clamp in frequent lightning stroke area.

articleTitle: Analysis of Bandwidth and Site Relationship for Power Communication Network Based on Analytic Hierarchy Process
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Circuits, Systems and Devices (ICCSD)
abstract: Power communication network is crucial for the stability and the efficiency of power grid system. To optimize communication network, bandwidth requirement of power grid must be estimated accurately. However, accurate bandwidth estimation for power grid is still an unresolved problem, mainly because bandwidth requirement may vary drastically for different power grid sites. In this paper, we propose an analysis method of bandwidth and site based on Analytic Hierarchy Process (AHP). In this method, node strength, site type, basic bandwidth and redundancy coefficient are introduced as indicators of the impact of site on bandwidth. The relative weights of different indicators are expressed by a judgment matrix. After passing the consistent test, the influence of different sites on bandwidth is obtained. Finally, an example is given to illustrate the validity of the model.

articleTitle: Orienteering Timing System Based on Sub-G Band Wireless Sensor Network
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Circuits, Systems and Devices (ICCSD)
abstract: Orienteering is a long-distance outdoor sport, in which electronic timing system plays an important role. However, the current production of electronic timing equipment technology on the Chinese market is still less developed in weight, volume, power consumption and other technical indicators compared with the international manufacturers in advanced level. Non-contact timer still has a big gap, and the price is too expensive, bulky and lack of portability. In order to solve this problems and improve the quality of directional movement of electronic timing equipment, this article adopted the new SoC as a master plan, design and implement a set of low power consumption, low cost, portable and reliable directional movement of the timing system, innovating the NFC tags and Sub-G communications functions.

articleTitle: A Ka Band 1.5W 27.5% PAE MMIC Power Amplifier in 0.15μm E-Mode GaAs pHEMT Process Co-analysis With Thermal Characteristic
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Circuits, Systems and Devices (ICCSD)
abstract: In this paper, a design of Ka-band monolithic microwave integrated circuit (MMIC) power amplifier (PA) in 0.15μm E-mode GaAs pHEMT process is presented. The PA is co-design with thermal analysis to enhance heat dissipation ability. Simulation result shows that, the PA exhibits 29dB of power gain, 32.4 dBm saturated output power (Psat) and more than 27.5% power added efficiency (PAE) from 34 GHz to 36GHz. The input return loss is lower than -18dB, and the output return loss is lower than -13.5dB. The PA maximum channel temperature can be lower than 114.9°C for 80°C MMIC backside. The PA is biased at VD of 3.7V and Vb of 0.6V. The total chip area is 4.2*2.2 mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>.

articleTitle: A Scan-Chain Circuit Design for BRAM Test Based on CLB
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Circuits, Systems and Devices (ICCSD)
abstract: This paper designs a BRAM test circuit with scan-chain structure based on CLB resources of FPGA, and implements it on XC7K325T. Post-PAR timing report show that the test speed of this design exceeds 300Mhz. Moreover, the design adopts modular structure, has good universality, and is convenient to transplant on different types of FPGA.

articleTitle: Theoretical Study and Simulation Analysis of Calculus Measurement System for VFTO
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Circuits, Systems and Devices (ICCSD)
abstract: In this paper, the calculus measurement system measuring fast transient overvoltage (VFTO) is analyzed and the parameters of each part of the system are calculated by theoretical calculation. The circuit is simulated by ATP-EMTP and the waveform of the result is compared with the ideal case, which shows that the response is affected by the stray parameters. To reduce the system error, two optimization schemes are proposed in this paper. First, the shielded electrode is replaced by the arch shield electrode in order to reduce the ground capacitance, and the possibility of creeping discharge and partial discharge. Second, resistors in series and capacitors in parallel are used to reduce the effect of residual inductance and residual inductance. The simulation results show that the effect of stray parameters can be effectively reduced.

articleTitle: Analysis and Rectification of Electromagnetic Compatibility in the Design and Assembling of Electronic Products
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Circuits, Systems and Devices (ICCSD)
abstract: In the process of designing and assembling of electronic products, the arrangement of chassis and cables has an important impact on the electromagnetic compatibility (EMC) of the system. In this paper, FDTD method is used in simulating the EMC problem caused by chassis slots and cables. Some suggestions on designing and assembling are proposed. Finally, our conclusions are further validated by the relevant experiments in the rectification of an ultrasound therapeutic instrument. It has certain guiding significance for the future EMC design.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of A Remote Firmware Upgrade Protocol for On-Board ECU
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Circuits, Systems and Devices (ICCSD)
abstract: With the continuous improvement of automobile electronization, the number of on-board ECU and the amount of software code in Car also increase greatly. The numerous and geographically dispersed on-board ECU and the increasing amount of code make on-board ECU firmware upgrades a huge challenge in terms of staffing, time and geographical management. This paper designs a communication protocol EVUGP that supports remote firmware upgrade, and introduces the protocol model, communication mechanism and frame structure of EVUGP, and provides a reliable and effective implementation mechanism for remote upgrade operation of on-board EUC firmware and related data.

articleTitle: Application of Infrared Non-destructive Defect Location in Components
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Circuits, Systems and Devices (ICCSD)
abstract: Application of the infrared non-destructive for defect location is presented in this work, including chips, capacitors and connectors. In these failure cases, common inspection equipment such as optical microscope, metallographic microscope and scanning electron microscope are used to inspect the appearance of components. No abnormalities were found. Besides, when the defects penetrate into the components and the size of the defect area is small, the defects cannot be located by the traditional non-destructive analysis method. However, Infrared imaging technology can be used without destroying the sample. Accurate detection of hot spots in components is achieved. Locate internal defects quickly and accurately. Realize the real sense of internal nondestructive positioning. Subsequently, the accuracy of infrared imaging method is verified by the various destructive physical analyses. This work provides a new research idea for the nondestructive defect location of components, including active, passive and electromechanical device. It can effectively guide the application of Infrared Nondestructive Testing Technology in failure location of various components.

articleTitle: Research on the Hybrid Pulse Width Modulation Strategy for Active-Neutral-Point-Clamped Three-Level Converter Based on IGCT
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Circuits, Systems and Devices (ICCSD)
abstract: Active-neutral-point-clamped (ANPC) three-level converter based on IGCT can balance the loss of switching devices. Because of the wide range of the output frequency of the three-level converter, the variation range of the carrier ratio in the whole speed range is also large. Therefore, the converter often adopts hybrid pulse width modulation strategy to meet the control requirements in the low frequency. Moreover, the impulse current of the transient process between the two modulated modes must be limited to ensure the normal operation of the converter. The mathematical model of ANPC topology and asynchronous motor load is established in the paper, in order to analyze the causes of stator impulse current between varies PDSPWM modes. Finally, the PSIM simulation results are provided to verify the effectiveness of the equation and to draw conclusions.

articleTitle: Fast Transient Disturbance Analysis on ECVT under High-Voltage Switch Operation
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Circuits, Systems and Devices (ICCSD)
abstract: To investigate the very fast transient disturbance caused by the high-voltage switch operation in power system, a test platform and circuit method is proposed to analyze the effect on Electronic Capacitor Voltage Transformer (ECVT). Firstly, an experimental platform is built to investigate the disturbance on ECVT under the switch operation, and then the calculation method is proposed on the main charge-discharge loop, all breakdown points of high-voltage switch are obtained by comparison between the variation curve of breakdown voltage and the voltage difference at source/load sides, the changing breakdown voltage is got by the gap distance in switch on/off operation. Furthermore, the equivalent circuit of switch operation is created in SPICE by connecting a piecewise linear source. Finally, the breakdown waveform of VFTO(very fast transient overvoltage) and transient current is obtained by the circuit simulation, its effect on ECVT is discussed.

articleTitle: 0.18μm CMOS Ring Oscillator at Liquid Helium Temperature
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Circuits, Systems and Devices (ICCSD)
abstract: This paper presents low power dissipation, low phase noise ring oscillators (ROs) based on Semiconductor Manufacturing International Corporation (SMIC) 0.18μm CMOS technology at liquid helium temperature (LHT). First, the characterization and modelling of CMOS at LHT are presented. The temperature-dependent device parameters are revised and the model then shows good agreement with the measurement results. The ring oscillator is then designed with energy efficiency optimization by application of forward body biasing (FBB). FBB is proposed to compensate for the threshold voltage (V<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">TH</sub>) shift to preserve the benefits of the enhancement of the carrier mobility at 4.2K The delay per stage (τ<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">p</sub>), the static current (I<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">STAT</sub>), the dynamic current (I<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">DYN</sub>), the power dissipation (P) and the phase noise (L(f<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">off</sub>)) are analyzed at both 298 K and 4.2 K, with and without FBB. The performance of the designed RO in terms of speed (τ<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">p</sub>=179ps), static current (23.55nA/stage), power dissipation (2.13μW) and phase noise (-177.57dBc/Hz@1MHz) can be achieved at 4.2K with the supply voltage (V<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">DD</sub>) reduced to 0.9 V.

articleTitle: Design of Multi-parameter Sensor System Based on Algorithm Correction
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Circuits, Systems and Devices (ICCSD)
abstract: With the advancement of modern marine detection technology, single parameter monitoring sensors have been incapable to adapt to complex and varied environments. In order to accomplish multi-parameter measurement in the water quality testing process, a low-power multi-parameter sensor based on BP network and least squares algorithm is proposed. Aiming at solving problems of poor accuracy, long sampling time and high-power consumption of sensors, a software and hardware optimization design combining algorithm is proposed. The results show that the sensor that the design can effectively realize temperature compensation and improve the parameter accuracy after the algorithm is processed by the algorithm. The hardware structure adopts low-power design and adjustable parameter design, which can reduce the system power consumption while minimizing the sampling time of some parameters. The software adopts FSM design to realize sensor mode selection. After testing, the multi-parameter detection system designed in this paper can meet the requirements of stability, accurate and low levels of power consumption in water quality testing.

articleTitle: Antenna Selection for Wiretap MIMO System with Wrapped Space Time Codes
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Circuits, Systems and Devices (ICCSD)
abstract: Wiretap has drawn much attention since more and more mobile handsets and wireless communication systems are emerging. To step over the limitation of single link for both sides, multiple-input multiple-out (MIMO) has been introduced in wiretap channels (wiretap MIMO). In this paper, a wiretap MIMO system is proposed combined with wrapped space time codes (WSTC). To enlarge the mutual information between Bob and Alice, a new antenna selection is proposed in the system. It is declared that, the AS algorithm based on K-means clustering can approach the optimal capacity with low computational complexity. Finally, the simulated results are presented to validate the proposed system.

articleTitle: Study on the Low Impedance Discharge Time Delay and Its Influence Factors in The Discharge Process of Shunt Capacitor and Discharge Core
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Circuits, Systems and Devices (ICCSD)
abstract: In order to attain the low impedance discharge time delay and its influence factors of shunt capacitor and discharge core, the discharge waveform is researched. The influences of discharge voltage, capacitance and resistance value on low impedance discharge time delay is grasped by test. It is indicated that the circuit is in low impedance discharge when the discharge current growth rate climbed to the peak value in extreme short time. The low impedance discharge time delay will decrease when discharge voltage rises, and the low impedance discharge time delay is stable when capacitance or resistance value changing.

articleTitle: Charged Board Event Simulation for Validating ESD Control Program of Hard Disk Drive Assembly Processes
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Circuits, Systems and Devices (ICCSD)
abstract: The ESD control program based on the CDM classification of HDD assembly process was currently set at less than 1000V; thus, the HDD PCBA should be able to withstanding the CDM voltage at least 1000V. The work validates that the ESD control program under 1000V provides a sufficient margin for protecting HDD PCBAs. Moreover, an experiment on HDD PCBA failure caused by CBE was performed under a CDM framework at 1500V for an extra margin. A particular failure analysis tool was employed for identifying an indication of PCB degradation using three parameters; magneto resistive resistance, variable gain amplifier and track error margin. The experiment of HDD PCBA enforced with CBE revealed that the HDD PCBA was still properly functioned after the test. The degradation was monitored by changes of analyzed parameters. The results show that there was no sign of degradation. Therefore, the ESD control program under 1000V provides a sufficient margin for a safe environment of HDD PCBA. This simulated CBE on HDD PCBA is useful to classify an ESD sensitivity class for assisting the design and protective apparatus for ESD susceptible items in the HDD assembly processes.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis Topologies with Coupling Capacitor Double Resonance Circuit for ECPT System
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Circuits, Systems and Devices (ICCSD)
abstract: The different topologies of coupling capacitor double resonance circuit are widely used in electric-field coupled power transfer system. But the different topologies have different application conditions and application fields. The characteristic impedances of 2-port networks with different topologies are analyzed, and the optimization parameters with different topologies are derived by impedance matching. The frequency characteristic of load power with different coupling capacitor and load are plot by comparative analysis.

articleTitle: An Improved Scheme of Victim Replication in Tiled Chip Multiprocessors
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Circuits, Systems and Devices (ICCSD)
abstract: The last level cache (LLC) in the shared configuration increases the effective cache capacity by not allowing replication but causes a long on-chip access latency when the data is on a remote tile. The previously proposed victim replication scheme allowed replicating victims evicted from L1 to its local LLC slice in order to reduce the on-chip access latency of subsequent L1 misses. However, this proposal loses sight of the impact of locality in all levels of cache and the L1 victim re-reference interval on replication and replicates lots of useless replicas, which results in limited performance improvements. In this paper, we propose a novel victim selective replication scheme based on L1 temporal locality, LLC reuse locality and L1 victim re-reference interval (VSR_TRV). We selectively replicate a victim that is detected as a reuse in a short L1 victim re-reference interval or recognized as the first time LLC access but only receives one L1 access, and filter out the replication of a victim that is recognized as the first time LLC access. The experimental results show that VSR_TRV can improve performance by 4.67% on average and by 11.22% at best over the previously proposed VR scheme. In addition, our proposal only incurs 1.48% storage overhead compared to that of the baseline system.

articleTitle: Train Carriage Warning System Based on Zigbee Wireless Sensor Network
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Circuits, Systems and Devices (ICCSD)
abstract: In order to realize the timely and accurate alarm for abnormal conditions in train carriage, a scheme of safety warning system based on zigbee technology is proposed. The hardware and software architecture of the system are designed. Meanwhile, the workflow and implementation process of each node are elaborated in detail. The system is composed of five parts: sensor node, zigbee router, coordinator, video module and the intelligent terminal. Firstly, the decibels received by the sound sensor are judged through threshold and sent to the coordinator through zigbee router module. Secondly, the video module analyzes the video of the alarming carriage by means of artificial intelligence. Finally, the detailed alarm information is sent to the intelligent terminal. The development cost of the system is low and its installation and maintenance is convenient. It improves the monitoring facilities of train carriages, which can guarantee the accuracy and real-time of the warning. It has good expansibility and portability, which is of practical significance for improving the safety of train operation.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Influencing Factors of Quality Factor of Series Resonance System with Large Capacity
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Circuits, Systems and Devices (ICCSD)
abstract: In Zhoushan transmission project, 500kV XLPE submarine cable lines are used for the first time in the world. In order to strictly assess the quality of cable laying and attachment installation of 500kV XLPE submarine cable lines, a large capacity series resonance system with high quality factor which is suitable for AC withstand voltage test is developed. In order to improve the energy utilization efficiency of AC withstand voltage test system, based on the physical significance of quality factor, combined with practical application scene, the main factors affecting the quality factor of large-capacity series resonance system are analyzed. The optimization method of quality factor of large capacity series resonance system is proposed qualitatively from two aspects of reducing reactor loss and external loss. The test results show that the quality factor of large capacity series resonance voltage test is up to 169.2, fully meet the 17km submarine cable line ac withstand voltage test requirements.

articleTitle: Analysis on Buffer Layer Discharges Below the Corrugated Aluminum Sheath of XLPE Cables and Comparison with Other Metal Sheath Structures
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Circuits, Systems and Devices (ICCSD)
abstract: The spiral corrugated aluminum sheath is most commonly used in HV XLPE land cables in China. In recent years, cable faults caused by discharge ablation of semi-conductive buffer layer below the aluminum sheath have been frequently reported, and a large scale of discharge traces on insulation screen surface have been found in the dismantled cables, which has aroused widespread concern. In this paper, after a brief summary of this kind of failure phenomena, the theoretical and experimental researches on the cause and mechanism of buffer layer failure are provided, with relevant conclusions listed. This is thought to be important for XLPE cables' structure optimization and performance improvement. Several kinds of aluminum sheath structures commonly used in HV XLPE cables out of China are also introduced, with their advantages and disadvantages as well as their application scopes, which has reference value for the development of cable industry.
